info.title: Mialo MSME Navigator API
info.description: Profile-driven funding readiness and scheme matching. Demo data is labelled via data_status on every record.

post.description:
Start a new, empty business (demo-mode self-registration) and get its token. The profile is
then filled through PUT /businesses/{id}/profile or the intent and document flows.

Understand a typed request, propose goal fields and return the follow-up questions. Saves
nothing.

Save confirmed proposals and answers; returns the remaining questions and a live preview of
how many schemes meet the criteria.

Obligations grouped as to_do, confirm, needs_info, done and not_applicable, with why each
applies, the questions that would settle the unclear ones, and the details of each obligation.

get.description: Topics worth getting help on, with the reason, computed from the latest results.

Every document the business can upload, with how much each adds to the readiness index for
its chosen loan type (importance), the tier table, and what is already backed.
